<thought>All provided data (C8H9O, DBE 5, 6 aromatic carbons, 1 carbonyl, fragments “c1ccccc1” and “C=O”, 5 unique carbon environments, 2 hydrogen environments) point to a benzene ring directly attached to a carbonyl group, i.e., benzaldehyde. The validated SMILES for benzaldehyde is “O=CC1=CC=CC=C1”.</thought>
<final_answer>O=CC1=CC=CC=C1</final_answer>
